informationUnits.title: Repeatability problem
mustCover: same application code can behave differently because its environment differs
the environment is part of the system

informationUnits.title: Environment diagnosis inputs
mustCover: runtime version
libraries or dependencies
expected files
environment variables
external dependencies

informationUnits.title: Container analogy boundary
mustCover: same recipe can produce different results in different environments
the analogy must not be treated as the literal container mechanism

informationUnits.title: Image container process
mustCover: image is the packaged starting point
container is a running instance
process is the actual application work
they are distinct

informationUnits.title: Host kernel and isolation
mustCover: container is not a full virtual machine
container shares the host kernel
namespaces and cgroups provide important isolation/resource control

informationUnits.title: Process and host relationship
mustCover: container isolation changes what a process can see
the host still supplies shared infrastructure
container boundaries do not remove host behavior

informationUnits.title: Short-lived command and lifecycle
mustCover: docker run --rm nginx:alpine nginx -t is a valid short-lived example
the process ending ends the short-lived container
container lifetime follows the process for such a command

informationUnits.title: Persistent data
mustCover: ordinary container writable state is disposable with the container
important data needs a persistent storage mechanism such as a volume
data lifecycle should be independent from container replacement

informationUnits.title: Container and host ports
mustCover: a process can listen on a container port
a host can publish that port differently
running is not proof of external reachability

informationUnits.title: Reachability diagnosis
mustCover: check process listening
check container-side port
check published host port
check client network path
restart is not a diagnosis

informationUnits.title: Multi-service application
mustCover: frontend, API, and database can be separate services
API needs a network path to database
database needs persistent data
frontend can often be disposable

informationUnits.title: Evidence and transfer
mustCover: inspect image/process/network/storage
make one controlled failure
observe evidence
repair the smallest broken boundary
verify recovery
the same reasoning transfers to Kubernetes and larger systems
